reviews.title: Does the job I need it to do.
reviews.comment: Had it running for a month so far, no problems yet.  Just make sure it's PROPERLY COOLED and you should be fine using it right out of the box. If you're into overclocking, I've heard RUMORS that these things can fail if you push it too far over factory specs, so OC at your own risk.  I'm not a computer engineer so I don't overclock my gear... so I have no further comment on it. I play some video games... not the brand new ones cuz they're too expensive, but titles like FFXIV, Starfield, and Satisfactory run with no serious problems with this chip.  I also watch movies and TV online, check emails, do a lot of report writing and PDF editing, and some digital mapping with GIS software... it all works as expected.  But as with any PC setup, use good judgement and common sense.  This chip is clearly overpowered for my needs, but I got it to "future-proof" my computer for another 6 years or so because I don't have the financial resources to replace my CPU every year when a new version is released.
reviews.author: Doctor Gangreene

reviews.title: Funciona perfecto, 32° CPU en reposo y 42° CPU jugando al F1 23
reviews.comment: Llevo un mes de uso con el i9 14900F y hasta ahora a funcionado perfecto, lo uso con refrigeración liquida y las temperaturas hasta ahora son 32°C CPU en reposo y jugando al F1 23 la temperatura del CPU no pasa de los 42°C. Lo uso con una RTX 4070 Super y no he tenido cuello de botella, he podido jugar en graficos altos y a la misma vez hacer streaming con la configuracion de maxima calidad del OBS y va todo excelente
